info.title: GigaLibs Organization API
info.description: WI-OI-109c (ADR-0018). Tenant and actor come from the server-validated session. Optimistic versions (expectedVersion) and idempotency keys travel in request bodies. Drafts never affect runtime scope.

post.summary: Archive a unit type with no units
Create a unit (not placed in any tree)

get.summary: Read a unit (ETag carries its version)

post.summary: Archive a unit outside every live or open version
Create the primary tree or an alternate tree
Open the tree's draft, copied from the active or a given published version

get.summary: The version in force now or at a given time
A tree's activation history, newest first
Read a version (ETag carries its lock version)
One level of a version: its roots or the children of a unit

patch.summary: Place, move or remove units in a draft

get.summary: What activating the version would change, and whose grants it touches

post.summary: Check a draft; valid drafts become validated
Submit a validated draft for approval
Approve a submitted version (never its author or submitter)
Reject a submitted or approved version
Freeze an approved version and build its closure and checksum
Activate a published version from now or a later time (idempotent)
Grant a member a unit and everything below it (idempotent)

BadRequest.description: The request does not match the contract.

Forbidden.description: The member lacks the permission, or the step needs a second person.

Conflict.description: Stale version, duplicate, wrong state or reused idempotency key; reload and retry.

Unprocessable.description: The change breaks an organization rule; validation problems are listed when known.
